attributes.source: NOAA GEFSv12 reforecast (noaa-gefs-retrospective, AWS NODD), SPFH/UGRD/VGRD on pressure levels, 00 UTC, 0.25 deg
attributes.steps: daily IVT of lead L = mean over the forecast hours 24(L-1)+6, +12, +18 and 24L of |Q|, Q = (1/g) * integral of q (u, v) dp over 1000, 925, 850, 700, 600, 500, 400, 300 hPa (trapezoid, Pa)
attributes.license: NOAA NODD: open to the public, attribution requested, no NOAA endorsement implied
attributes.lead_convention: lead L = precipitation over forecast hours (24(L-1), 24L] of the 00 UTC run; valid_date = init_date + L - 1 (UTC day 00-24 h)
attributes.notes: inits 2000-01-01..2019-12-31 only (the 2020 prefix holds a single misplaced 2010-07-01 init)
